criteria.text: The response identifies that Sovex's indemnity of Ludis in Supply Agreement Section 11.2, which covers all Grower Claims whatever their cause, sits outside the liability cap, so Sovex faces unlimited liability, including for grower losses caused by Ludis's own defective or nonconforming seed.
The response locates the uncapped indemnity issue in the Supply Agreement at Section 11.2 (alone or together with the Grower Claims definition and/or Section 12.3).
For the uncapped Grower Claims indemnity, the response explains why this matters to Sovex and recommends a fix.
hints: carve out claims caused by Supplier

criteria.text: The response identifies that Sovex's March 30, 2026 germination-shortfall notice on the first delivery was sent after the 21-day notice window, which closed on March 13, 2026 based on the February 20, 2026 Delivery Date.

The response locates the late germination notice issue in the Order Form No. 2 recital recording the first delivery and notice history (Recital B) and/or its reservation of rights section, or in Supply Agreement Section 8.4.
For the late germination notice, the response explains why this matters to Sovex and recommends a fix or course of action.

The response identifies that the Supply Agreement renews automatically for successive three-year terms unless non-renewal notice is given within a narrow 30-day window (no more than 150 and no less than 120 days before the end of the term).
The response locates the automatic renewal issue in Supply Agreement Section 2.2.
For the automatic renewal provision, the response explains why this matters to Sovex and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that the Supply Agreement exclusivity clause extends to soybean and sorghum seed (not only corn) and to the whole of the United States and Canada, which is broader than the corn-only Iowa and Nebraska deal in the Order Form.
The response locates the overbroad exclusivity issue in Supply Agreement Section 4.1.
For the overbroad exclusivity clause, the response explains why this matters to Sovex and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that the Data Processing Addendum selects Iowa law and Polk County, Iowa courts for disputes relating to the Addendum, the Agreement or Grower Data, and that this conflicts with the New York law and New York forum chosen in the Supply Agreement rather than being resolved in favour of New York.
hints: laws of the State of Iowa

criteria.text: The response locates the governing law conflict in Data Processing Addendum Section 12.
For the governing law and forum conflict, the response explains why this matters to Sovex and recommends a fix.
The response states that the Order Form sales Territory is Iowa and Nebraska.
The response states that the Supply Agreement's Initial Term ends on December 31, 2028.
The response is a memo that presents the issues as separate items, ordered so that the items with the greatest commercial or legal exposure for Sovex come first.
The response claims that Sovex's March 30, 2026 germination notice was timely under the Supply Agreement.
The response claims that the Supply Agreement's exclusivity restriction is limited to corn seed in Iowa and Nebraska.
